user.title: Select your Hue bridge
user.description: Select a loaded official Philips Hue v2 integration. No additional pairing is needed.

abort.no_hue: Configure and load the official Philips Hue v2 integration first.

init.title: Bridge polling
init.description: Active mode waits for the first official Hue event. Continuous mode uses bridge traffic while idle. The interval is in seconds.

data_description.source: * Quick selection uses the button’s short-press lights: individual lights, groups and lists. For scenes and scripts, choose Custom lights.

button_1.name: Button 1
button_1.description: Short press has no recognition delay unless double or triple press is enabled. Multi-press interval: up to 350 ms; Bridge batching can add up to 1.35 s of waiting. Long press runs once. Target: lights/groups, or one scene or script.
